# AWF efforts

When effort memory, a plan, an ADR, or worktree isolation becomes relevant, or before completing or integrating implementation work, run the repository's AWF command with `docs effort`, read the guide, and follow it for the task. Reuse the guide during the task; do not load it at every session start or before every action.
